scope: Documentary integrity, qualified claims, concise factual summaries and shared geographical focuses. Bibliographic metadata and original explanatory copy are excluded from summary word counts. Geometry, renders and browser behavior are verified separately.

checks.label: Eighteen stable stops and coherent route totals
Every fact and chronology item resolves to evidence with stated confidence
Five regions partition the route and match thematic model layers
Geographical focuses and registration match the exported model plan
Two public spaces retain distinct shared context coordinates
1248 and the Cid association remain qualified claims
